principle: No case-ID PASS logic. Compare independent expectations and explicit execution phase.

projections.analysis_state: scope-projected input ranking/pending presence; raw state retained
projections.analysis_intent: not_finalized iff no executable main requirements; raw intent/sentiment retained as diagnostics
projections.blocked_plan: no requirements; sentiment reflects only user_intent or partial Goal known sentiment, never a guessed raw routing hint
projections.effective_scope: exact normalized scope identity/products/windows from gold, not outputs
projections.pending_goal: post-turn legal state; if input pending exists and preservation is required, goal/scope/source task remain identical
projections.acceptance: supports null, subset partial/failed, and explicit absent-or-failure rule
projections.rag: frozen separate contract and permitted_keys; no RAG permission changes
projections.pre_tool_block: catalog transaction/GUC reads before planning allowed; registry/data calls and classifiers after known block forbidden

phase_rules.clarification: no executable plan; needs_clarification; zero query/registry/retrieval/classification; no facts or complete=true
phase_rules.preparation_block: preserve compiled plan and frozen target; verify named reason/statistics validation count; zero prefetch/classification/public topics
phase_rules.partial_publication: retain exact required_aspects and per-child statuses, publish only specified independently accepted aspects; parent partial/false
phase_rules.plan_fault_rejection: verify independent Goal, false plan check and final rejection; no tools/classification; injected planner deviations are reported separately
phase_rules.result_fault_rejection: verify final source/numeric rejection and no publication; altered artifact is the expected injected deviation
phase_rules.completed_or_insufficient: compare output scope/capability and acceptance; numeric success never substitutes for semantic task acceptance

metrics.natural_module_denominator: all turns except explicitly injected faults (60)
metrics.tool_before_block: all clarification/preparation-block/plan-fault-block turns; denominator computed from frozen contracts
metrics.strict_completion: unchanged v1 strict_business_completion=true and expected successful analysis/RAG-permission goals; excludes deliberate faults
metrics.v1_comparison: historical only; expanded/phase-aware denominators are not quality trend evidence
